title: Dresden Zwinger
visualBrief: The Dresden Zwinger encloses an open courtyard with curved sandstone arcades, four corner pavilions, two domed end pavilions and Semper Gallery. The copper and gold Kronentor frames the open passage and its stone moat crossing.
nativeAxes: Positive X runs from the Wallpavillon toward the Glockenspielpavillon. Positive Z runs from Semper Gallery toward the Kronentor and its moat bridge.
